findings.title: Audio models fetch toasts errors on every prompt mount
findings.problem: getAudioModels calls api.get('v1/audio_transcription_models') without skipErrorHandling, and ChatPrompt invokes it in a mount effect for all users (not only those with stt_support). api.ts calls handleError (a toaster.error) on any non-OK response unless skipErrorHandling is set. An empty result is also never cached (early return only when sttModels.length is truthy), so users with no audio models trigger a new request on every ChatPrompt mount.
findings.impact: Any 403/404/5xx from the endpoint (older backend, users without STT access) surfaces an error toast on each chat open for users who never use voice input. The fetch is a background capability probe, so this is user-visible noise on the main chat screen.
findings.recommendation: Pass { skipErrorHandling: true } to api.get in getAudioModels (the catch already logs and returns []). Optionally track an in-flight promise / fetched flag so empty results and concurrent mounts do not refetch.
